description: This file contains the implementation of the Point of Sale module for an Odoo (OpenERP) system, including classes for POS orders, order lines, payments, and related reports, with methods for handling order processing, invoicing, accounting entries, and stock movements.

classes.name: pos_config_journal
classes.description: Configuration class for POS journals, defining fields for description, code, and linked journal.

classes.name: pos_order
classes.description: Main class representing a POS order, including methods for order lifecycle management, invoicing, accounting, stock picking, and payments.

classes.name: pos_order_line
classes.description: Represents individual lines within a POS order, with methods for price calculation, product scanning, and validation.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Handles payments associated with POS orders, including default journal selection and validation.

classes.name: report_transaction_pos
classes.description: A report class for POS transaction summaries, implemented as a database view.

methods.name: pos_config_journal
methods.description: Constructor for POS configuration journal class.

methods.name: pos_order
methods.description: Includes methods for order deletion, partner pricelist update, total calculations, payment handling, invoicing, account moves, order state transitions, stock picking, and refunds.

methods.name: pos_order_line
methods.description: Methods for price calculation, product lookup, order line creation/modification, and deletion validation.

methods.name: pos_payment
methods.description: Methods for retrieving default journals and creating/updating payments.

methods.name: report_transaction_pos
methods.description: Initializes the database view for POS transaction reporting.
